title: What's left over: second fifth of households, 2020-2024
cap: BLS Consumer Expenditure Survey, second fifth of consumer units ranked by income before taxes: (income before taxes minus total average annual expenditures) as % of income before taxes, nominal dollars. Spending includes Social Security deductions and pension contributions but not income taxes; mortgage principal and loan repayments are excluded. Negative = reported spending above reported income. Book arithmetic.
